small_guidance:
- Swap the program decomposition: make pid_oc tile the full OC axis with BLOCK_OC=16 (=OC), and have pid_sp tile output-spatial in chunks (BLOCK_SP=8 or 16) so the inner ic/k loops reuse loaded weights across multiple output positions instead of reloading w for every single pooled voxel.
- Add autotune configs that vary num_warps∈{2,4,8} with num_stages∈{2,3,4} together with a BLOCK_SP tile, and key on (N,OC,POD,POH,POW); current single-point-per-program design under-utilizes warps.
- Hoist the weight load out of the spatial loop: load w[ic, :, kd, kh, kw] once per (ic,kd,kh,kw) and reuse across the 2x2x2 pool window and adjacent spatial tiles.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as an im2col-style GEMM: one program per (N, OC tile, pooled-spatial tile). For each pooled output (pd,ph,pw), enumerate the 8 sub-positions and their valid (ic,kd,kh,kw) contributions as the K dimension; accumulate via tl.dot against a [K, BLOCK_OC] weight tile. This turns the current scalar FMA loop into tensor-core matmul.
- Alternative: scatter-add design — one program per (N, input-spatial tile, IC), compute input*weight outer product [BLOCK_SP, BLOCK_OC] via tl.dot, then atomically accumulate / pre-bin into the pooled output grid by dividing the output coord by 2. This makes input reuse explicit (each input voxel touches KD*KH*KW outputs) and matches the natural data-flow of ConvTranspose3d.
- Use NHWC/channels_last layout for both input and weight so the IC (and OC) axis is the contiguous GEMM-K (and -N) dimension, enabling coalesced vector loads; precompute valid (kd,kh,kw,id,ih,iw) index tables per pooled tile on host to remove the divmod chain from the inner loop.
